audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and manipulating Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime dependencies on Apache POI.

capabilities.text: The library provides Workbook, Worksheet, and Cells collections for reading and writing string, numeric, boolean, date/time, and formula values.
capabilities.title: Read, write, and edit Excel .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Style objects carry font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection flags; row/column sizing, visibility, and outline grouping are supported.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: ValidationCollection and ConditionalFormattingCollection allow defining data rules and visual formatting for CellArea ranges.
capabilities.title: Validate data and apply conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Pictures, comments, shapes, and Excel tables (ListObjects) can be added, retrieved, and removed with appropriate positioning and styling.
capabilities.title: Embed and manage drawing objects

capabilities.text: PageSetup, WorksheetProtection, WorkbookProtection, and WorkbookView provide control over print options, protection, and window layout.
capabilities.title: Configure page setup and print layout

capabilities.text: LoadOptions exposes strictMode, tryRepairPackage, and tryRepairXml flags; Workbook.getLoadDiagnostics() returns detailed repair and preservation notes.
capabilities.title: Load diagnostics and repair

capabilities.text: AutoFilter supports color, dynamic, top-10, and custom filters; 18 of 25 ChartType values can be created programmatically.
capabilities.title: Support auto filters and charts

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, and Map) cannot be created programmatically; they round-trip only when loaded from an existing workbook.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped, but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.
A handful of public XML-mapper classes are unimplemented skeleton code carried over from an early scaffold.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation and editing of Excel workbooks with cell values, formulas, styling, and layout control using a pure Java API.
Supports robust loading of potentially corrupted Excel files via strict mode toggles and repair options, with diagnostics reporting.
Provides data validation and conditional formatting capabilities scoped to worksheet ranges for enforcing and highlighting data rules.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source, pure-Java spreadsheet library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks targeting Java 17.

uncertainties: The exact set of 183 public types and their full API surface beyond what is shown in examples and public_symbol facts is not fully enumerated.
Whether the unimplemented XML-mapper classes are ever invoked by internal save/load paths is not confirmed by the provided facts.
The behavior of ChartEx types when saved and reloaded is not demonstrated in the examples.

workflows.name: Create and style workbook
workflows.text: Instantiate a Workbook, access a Worksheet, write values to Cells, apply Style to individual cells, and save the result as .xlsx.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing workbook using LoadOptions with repair flags, inspect diagnostics for issues, modify metadata, and save the repaired output.

workflows.name: Apply validation and conditional formatting
workflows.text: Add data validation and conditional formatting rules to a CellArea, configure style for conditional formats, and save the workbook.
